'''Estah Kloy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a personnel [[Agent/Legends|agent]] on board [[Carrick Station]] and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Personnel Agent who appears on both the Republic and Imperial Fleets, Estah Kloy was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']].<ref name="TOR" />
